summary: Iteration 6: Validated self-reported (Copilot/Comet/Other) course-attempt flow end-to-end. 16/16 pytest cases pass covering attempt creation (agent_label defaults, expires_at ~2h, invalid kind -> 422), /mine listing, full station walk (start->wall->doors->rope->beam->tunnel->finish) with nonce extraction, early submit 409, bad code 422 with 'N tries left', good-code verification (server_elapsed_s computed, reported_elapsed_s echoed, score.total present, reported time doesn't affect score), reuse 409, cross-user 403, cross-attempt rejection, 5-bad-code lockout, Mongo-backdated expiry (station page 'Attempt expired', clear 409, submit 410), leaderboard source=self_reported/verified filters, per-attempt submit rate-limit 429. Frontend /arena self-report-panel verified: agent chips (copilot/comet/other), label input appears for Other, start creates attempt, agent badge shows Comet, attempt URL, progress 0/7, expiry countdown, bad-code error surfaced in self-report-message. Reload restores open attempt via /course-attempts/mine (confirmed when attempt is in-flight; after cleanup there is none to restore). /leaderboard source chips filter correctly; self-reported rows render 'Self-reported' badge, 'Comet · own browser' subtitle and time '1.6s (reported 5.5s)'. No React Router future-flag warnings in console. Home, Arena, Leaderboard pages render clean.
critical_code_review_comments: course_store.submit_self_report compares code bytes but still raises 'already finished' before expiry check for an already-submitted expired attempt — minor UX quirk; current paths all return correct HTTP codes.

Rate limiter is in-memory per process (noted in request); tests had to space attempt creations across free+pro users and wait ~60s between retries to avoid false 429s. Not a bug, but documenting for next agent.

seed_data_creation: Created and then cleaned up ~5 self-report attempts for free/pro users (course_attempts with agent_kind != null). One leaderboard row (Comet 99 pts) was removed post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Self-report backend+frontend verified in iteration 6. Rate limit windows are 60s/process; if re-running test_self_report.py back-to-back, wait >=60s or restart backend to clear buckets. Cleanup query: db.course_attempts.delete_many({user_id: <uid>, agent_kind: {$ne: null}}). Only /arena self-report panel + /leaderboard source chips were exercised beyond regression smoke; previous iteration coverage for runs/relay/BYOK/Stripe/tournaments/stadium/cards is still valid.
